title: Getting Started Guide - GenStone
text:
Getting Started Guide
We've pulled all of our best project resources together on one page including our sample size recommendations, how to measure and our Project SOS button where you can request on demand help from one of our Project Coordinators.
Getting Started Guide Get Help Now

How Can We Help? On Demand Project Support

How to Measure Do it Yourself or Give Us a Call

What Size Sample? Full Panel or 12" x 12"

Get in the Guide
Follow These Steps or Give Us a Call

Use our project calculator for instant pricing or tap Project SOS to speak with one of our Project Coordinators for on demand project assistance at any step in the process below.

Price My Project Project SOS

What's Possible

GenStone can be used both inside and out, browse our inspiration gallery to see how other customers have improved their homes with GenStone.

Inspiration Gallery

Visualize It

Snap a picture of the area(s) you want to improve with GenStone and we'll show you what it would look like in any stone or brick color.

Request Rendering

Read Reviews

See what our customers have to say about working with our Project Coordinators, installing GenStone and our support team.

Reviews

#MyGenStoneDIY

Watch candid stories from our customers showing off their GenStone projects while also offering install insights.

Watch Videos

Buy Sample(s)

Purchase a sample of the color(s) you want to see up close and don't forget, we'll refund you for the color you purchase for your project.

Shop Samples

Measure

Figure out the length and height of your install area(s). Plug these measurements into our online calculator or give us a call so we can double check your estimate.

How Do I Measure?

How to Install

From step by step guided tutorials with Zach and Amanda to guides, specs sheet, tips and tricks, this is your resource for all things install.

Installing GenStone

Order

Buy online, through one of our thousands of retailers or directly from your own personal Project Coordinator at GenStone.

View My Cart

Support

Download your post purchase guide and engage with our five star rated support team for delivery, returns and more.

Download Guide

Meet Our Project Coordinators

On Demand Help • No Obligation • No Additional Cost
